notes: Variant WLC.1CH.12.15.v003 is underdetermined and the projection carries r00-base; s018 and s019 aligned as given (rule 9).

Correction: in the first month the single English the moves from the noun's assimilated article (s009) to the adjective's article (s011). Rule 47 governs an attributive phrase holding more article morphemes than the ASV renders, and its test is which word the the stands before; here that word is first. The accepted reading's own note conceded that rule 47 pointed the other way.
